title: Remote Office Assistant
description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

title: Senior Shopify Developer
description:
We are hiring a contract-based Senior Shopify Developer to contribute to our Design and Development Team.

Original Job posting link here

 

🌎About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Plus, our partner organizations

  • Lightphone
  • Mill
  • IngredientAI

 

🔮 Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.

In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.
  • Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).
  • Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.
  • Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.
  • Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.
  • Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.
  • Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.
  • Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

 

🔑 Must-Have Competencies:

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

  • 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.
  • Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js.
  • Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).
  • Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).
  • Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.
  • Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.
  • Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.
  • Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

 

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies:

  • Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.
  • Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.
  • Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.
  • WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.
  • Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).
  • Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

 

💸 Compensation

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

 
🎤 How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

 
👩‍🏭 How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

title: Senior Independent Software Developer
description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

title: Founding Account Executive – Benelux
description:
Your Impact

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit, a proven playbook, and now we're taking it into the rest of Europe.

Benelux is one of our first markets. The Netherlands and Belgium hold a dense base of high-tech and industrial manufacturers, and the category is still wide open there. That's where you come in. You take the region and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates, and win the first customers and reference logos that everything else builds on. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows Benelux from there. A real greenfield, with the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market.

You're not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. This is a highly strategic GTM role where you work hands-on to close the first deals and set the base for everything that comes afterwards. You're based with us in Munich and travel into your market.

Your Tasks

  • Open up Benelux end to end: sharpen the ICP for Dutch and Belgian manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the region's growth

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case, closing

  • Work hand in hand with the expansion team and develop the outbound playbook for your market: messaging, sequences, segments, channels

  • Coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline

  • Feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership, and shape how Tacto expands internationally

Your Profile

  • Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • An entrepreneurial mindset above all: you want to build and own a market result, explore what works, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn't exist yet

  • Hands-on and self-driven: you go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline. You've carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • You grasp complex products and sell value over features, translating technical depth into business impact

  • Fluent, business-level English. Dutch is a strong plus, French an advantage for the Belgian market. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • You're based in Munich or ready to relocate. This is an on-site role - you build Benelux from our Munich office and travel into the market

Who Thrives Here

You run your market like a founder runs a company. You're a hunter, hands-on to the core: you send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries, and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. You go through the mud and build as you go, turning what works into a system the next person can run. And you think beyond the next deal. You're not just winning customers, you're laying Tacto's foundation in your region: externally through brand, network, and reference logos, and internally through the playbook and the case for the market.

Interview Process

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you'd be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

    • Monatsabschluss & Investoren-Reporting: Du bist von Anfang an in jeden Schritt unseres Monatsabschlusses und des Investoren-Reportings eingebunden. Am Ende übernimmst du diese wichtigen Aufgaben sogar komplett selbstständig für echtes Ownership.
    • Accounting Operations: Du bist ganzheitlich für unser Rechnungsmanagement zuständig. Konkret bedeutet das: Du erstellst und versendest Ausgangsrechnungen über Easybill und prüfst sowie erfasst Eingangsbelege routiniert in DATEV.
    • Prozessoptimierung & Team-Support: Du entlastest andere Teams in ihrem Arbeitsalltag, indem du bereichsübergreifende Prozesse optimierst. Je nachdem, was im Unternehmen gerade ansteht, baust du aussagekräftige Dashboards in Metabase sowie HubSpot auf und nutzt mitunter KI, um Aufgaben und Workflows effizienter zu gestalten.

  • Du erkennst Zusammenhänge zwischen verschiedenen Prozessen und Datenpunkten und organisierst deine Arbeitsschritte selbstständig und detailgenau.
  • Du kannst in dynamischen Phasen deine Aufgabenlogik eigenständig anpassen und priorisieren, welche Themen gerade den größten Impact haben.

  • Du bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverhalte und Zahlen klar und verständlich zu kommunizieren
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1) als auch auf Englisch (B2).

Wir wissen, dass diverse Teams besser performen. Wenn du dich in der klassischen Arbeitswelt oft nicht repräsentiert fühlst, ist das ein Grund mehr, dich bei uns zu bewerben.
Aber: wir möchten nicht vorgeben, diverser und inklusiver zu sein, als wir es aktuell sind. Wir haben Lücken, die wir mit einem wachsenden Team schließen möchten. Falls es für dich bestimmte Herausforderungen gibt, finden wir gemeinsam heraus, was du brauchst, ohne es zu deiner Aufgabe zu machen.

  • Unbegrenzter Zugriff auf unsere voiio-Plattform - von Vorträgen und Freizeitangeboten über Fitnesskurse bis hin zu psychologischer Unterstützung
  • Gesponsertes Deutschlandticket oder monatlicher Wunschgutschein
  • Individuelle Förderung durch Feedback und einen Learning & Development Plan
  • Die Gelegenheit, deine Ideen einzubringen, indem du von Beginn an selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich arbeitest

title: Product Manager — Kits and Integrated Workflows
description:
At ONI, we are driven by a profound mission: to propel scientific discovery and combat diseases by granting everyone the ability to visualize, comprehend, and share the intricate microscopic details of life. Our revolutionary Nanoimager and Aplo Platform stand at the forefront of advancing cellular studies on a molecular level, making substantial contributions to the evolution of scientific knowledge. 

We’re looking for a product manager to own our kits and workflows, including EV Profiler and LNP Profiler, now that the concept is proven. You’ll make sure sample preparation, fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software work together as one system, and your responsibility is the complete customer experience, from sample to scientifically meaningful result. The job is making that system rock solid: hardening what’s already on the market, making sure it works the same way at every site, and getting more customers on it without support load growing at the same rate. 


The Role

As part of the Product team, you’ll own the product management of our kits and end-to-end workflows, including the Discovery Kit, EV Profiler and LNP Profiler and their future revisions. You will ensure these work together with automated sample preparation and fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software to deliver reliable, reproducible and intuitive solutions for our customers.  

The initial products have launched, and the work now is making them dependable, repeatable, and scalable for our customers. You’ll create clarity and momentum for the R&D teams by understanding which problems matter, turning customer and market evidence into priorities, and removing barriers to delivering a coherent solution. You’ll grow adoption to routine use across many sites, including bioprocessing and QC settings where results must be reproducible and defensible, and you’ll work with Marketing on positioning and the product story as the portfolio evolves. You will play a critical role in bringing these quality improvements to the market and ensuring that current and future kits maintain their quality over time, and you’ll help define the roadmap for next iterations of existing and future kits and workflows. As a product manager, you’ll be the connective tissue between software, hardware, bioware, support, and the field, acting as the voice of the customer to help internal teams better understand our customers’ needs and problems.  

The role is ideal for a technically curious, commercially aware individual who loves getting hands-on with products, takes ownership of outcomes and thrives on complex, cross-functional challenges. You will work broadly across our platform and alongside US colleagues; the position is based in Oxford and involves occasional travel to customers and our US team (typically 10-20%). 


What you’ll do

  • Understand scientists and their complete workflows first-hand. Work with customers and field teams, study usage and support data, and synthesize their sometimes conflicting inputs into the problems worth solving. 

  • Drive evidence-led product direction and priorities across our solutions with R&D and commercial leaders, balancing customer outcomes, differentiation, adoption, reliability, margin and technical feasibility. 

  • Own the roadmap for our kits (including the Discovery Kit and the EV and LNP Profiler kits) and workflows, balancing quality, reliability, usability and new features. 

  • Build and refine market and product requirements (MRD/PRD) across workflows, from sample preparation (Aplo Flow) through acquisition (Aplo Scope) to analysis (CODI), according to our Product Development Process. 

  • Own validation for each kit and workflow: define acceptance criteria, performance specifications and validation plans, including reference samples and reproducibility across instruments, operators and sites. Work with R&D, who own development and verification. 

  • Drive coherence across our end-to-end solutions, ensuring kits, reagents, lab automation, instruments and software evolve together rather than as disconnected products. Champion reproducibility, usability and reliable results across the complete workflow. 

  • Connect R&D, operations, quality, service, field applications, sales, marketing and customers. Establish feedback loops, clear ownership and effective cross-team decisions. 

  • Own pricing and packaging for our kits and workflows, balancing customer value, competitiveness and margin targets. 

  • Work with Marketing throughout a product's life to shape positioning, the value proposition and the product story as the portfolio evolves, not only at launch. 

  • Lead launch and release planning with R&D, Marketing and the field: set readiness criteria, make go/no-go decisions, and coordinate documentation, release notes and training for each launch or revision. 

  • Create and run webinars and internal training for the field application and sales teams on new products and revisions, and keep an accurate record of what each kit, instrument and software version can deliver. 

  • Track post-launch performance, including adoption, kit reorders, time to first result, reproducibility, support burden, customer feedback and commercial results, and use it to set priorities. 

  • Analyze support tickets, logs and customer feedback to identify recurring failure modes, and prioritize root-cause fixes into the roadmap. 

  • Work with Quality and Operations on manufacturing transfer, life cycle support and end of life, so our kits and workflows maintain quality over time. 


What you’ll bring

  • A life-science background, ideally EVs, LNPs, nanoparticle characterization, imaging or biophysics. Being able to speak the language of our customers is critical. An MSc/PhD or equivalent hands-on experience is a real plus. 

  • Fluency across software, instruments, laboratory workflows and multidisciplinary R&D; comfortable investigating issues hands-on and understanding how the system fits together. 

  • Experience working with empowered, cross-functional development teams: knowing when to provide context, decide on a trade-off and leave the solution to specialists. 

  • Product management (or product owner) experience in life-science tools or instrumentation, ideally taking something from first release to a scaled, supported product.  

  • Experience planning and running launches with Marketing, R&D and the field, from development through adoption. 

  • Commercial and pricing judgement: You can weigh customer value, competitiveness and margin when setting price and packaging. 

  • A quality mindset: You’re comfortable writing acceptance criteria and test plans, and you think about risk, reproducibility and traceability. Exposure to a quality system (ISO 9001 or 13485) is a plus. 

  • Comfort with data: logs, tickets, precision and method-comparison numbers (CVs, site to site). Evidence sets priorities, not the loudest voice. 

  • The ability to lead across software, hardware, bioware, support and field without owning any of them, and to prioritize when everything feels urgent. 

  • Clear writing and organization skills. Requirements, release notes and docs that other people can act on. 


Nice to have

  • Super-resolution or single-molecule imaging experience (dSTORM, PALM, DNA-PAINT), or general microscopy experience (TIRF, widefield, confocal, spinning-disk). 

  • Hands-on EV or LNP work in research, biopharma, gene therapy or drug delivery. 

  • Laboratory automation, automated liquid handling, sample preparation, consumable kits, workflow integration, scientific software or data analysis. 

  • Integrating instruments, software, consumables and automated lab workflows; exposure to verification, validation, quality systems or lifecycle support. 

  • Commercialization, pricing, segmentation, product positioning or product marketing in technically sophisticated markets.

title: Data Enablement Officer
description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

Data Enablement Officer

Help shape how Efficio uses data responsibly, securely and effectively.

We are looking for a Data Enablement Officer to establish and lead Efficio’s data governance framework, helping us protect client data while enabling its responsible use across our services, analytics, products and AI capabilities.

This is a highly visible role at the intersection of data, technology, AI, risk and client delivery. You will work across the business to turn complex contractual, regulatory, privacy and security requirements into practical guidance that enables teams to innovate with confidence.

Initially, the role will have a strong advisory and enablement focus: helping teams understand client requirements, assess new uses of data and make proportionate, risk-based decisions. As our governance model matures, the role is expected to take greater ownership of the framework and delegated authority for lower-risk decisions.

What you'll be doing

Establish our data governance framework

You will assess our current data-handling practices and develop a practical, scalable governance framework covering the lifecycle of client data – from collection and classification through to access, use, sharing, storage, retention and secure deletion.

You will develop and maintain policies and standards covering areas including:

  • Client data handling and classification

  • Data reuse and fair usage

  • Use of client data within Efficio products

  • Use of data with AI tools, including third-party and self-hosted solutions

  • Data access and security

  • Retention, archiving and secure disposal

  • Anonymisation and aggregation

  • Third-party data sharing

  • Policy exceptions and escalation

You will also help establish and maintain our information asset inventories, data flows and AI asset registers.

Enable responsible use of data and AI

A key part of the role will be helping teams determine what we can do with data, under what conditions, and with what safeguards.

You will establish a consistent approach for assessing new and changing data use cases, considering factors such as:

  • Why the data was originally obtained

  • Client and contractual restrictions

  • Data sensitivity and classification

  • The proposed use and intended recipients

  • Security and access controls

  • Retention requirements

  • Legal, client and reputational considerations

For AI use cases, you will help define which activities are permitted, restricted, require additional review or are prohibited. This will include the use of prompts, uploaded files and connected data sources, as well as expectations around human oversight, output validation and accountability.

Govern products, platforms and technology

You will define the conditions under which client data can be stored or processed using Efficio products, SaaS platforms, cloud services and AI tools.

Working closely with Technology, Information Security, Legal and Privacy teams, you will assess areas including:

  • Data residency and international transfers

  • Encryption, access controls and logging

  • Supplier and subcontractor access

  • Data retention, backups and deletion

  • Exit and data-export arrangements

  • Use of customer data for AI model training, product improvement or other secondary purposes

You will help ensure that unapproved platforms are not used for client data without appropriate assessment and documented approval.

Support new solutions and innovation

You will work alongside teams designing and deploying new data, software, analytics and AI solutions, providing governance input from an early stage.

Ahead of launch, you will help confirm that the appropriate governance, legal, privacy and security reviews have taken place and that material risks have been appropriately addressed.

Where issues remain, you will recommend practical remediation, escalation or, where necessary, a delay to rollout. Acceptance of significant residual risk will remain with the appropriate executive or governance committee.

Build governance that works in practice

This role isn't simply about writing policies. We want to create a governance model that teams can understand and use.

You will help develop:

  • A clear data governance operating model and decision-rights framework

  • Practical data, AI, security, reuse and retention policies

  • Data and AI use-case assessment processes

  • Risk-classification and escalation models

  • Policy exception processes and decision registers

  • Product and AI platform assessment standards

  • Solution launch-readiness checklists

  • Training, guidance and supporting materials

  • Governance reporting for senior leadership and relevant committees

You will coordinate, advise and constructively challenge stakeholders across the organisation while recognising that responsibility for managing data risk is shared across business owners, data owners, Legal and Privacy, Information Security, Technology and senior governance forums.

Client engagement

This will also be an important client-facing role.

You will participate in client discussions where required, confidently explaining Efficio's approach to data governance, security and responsible data use.

You should be comfortable responding to questions about how client data is accessed, used, stored, shared, retained and protected, translating technical or governance concepts into clear, credible explanations for different audiences.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone with experience across one or more of the following areas:

  • Data governance or data management

  • Data privacy

  • Information security

  • Technology or operational risk

  • AI governance or responsible AI

You will also bring a practical understanding of modern technology environments, including SaaS, cloud, analytics and AI platforms.

You'll be someone who can operate comfortably between policy and practice – able to understand complex requirements while recognising the commercial and operational realities of a consulting and technology-enabled business.

In particular, you will be able to:

  • Translate complex regulatory, contractual and security requirements into practical business guidance

  • Apply proportionate, risk-based judgement rather than relying on a purely rules-based approach

  • Influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively

  • Work effectively across Technology, Security, Legal, Privacy and business teams

  • Balance commercial objectives and innovation with appropriate governance

  • Communicate confidently with clients and senior internal stakeholders

  • Build processes and frameworks that are robust without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Navigate emerging areas where the answer may not always be immediately clear

What success looks like

Success in this role will mean that teams understand how to use data appropriately rather than simply being told what they cannot do.

We will look at measures including adoption of priority policies, review turnaround times, reduction in unapproved tool usage, effective management of exceptions, quality of governance reporting, stakeholder feedback and a reduction in recurring governance issues.

Ultimately, the role will be judged on its ability to achieve both sides of our data ambition: protecting our clients and Efficio while enabling appropriate, secure and innovative use of data and AI.

title: Junior Data & Automation Engineer
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The Data & Automations Team

The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability.

The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions.

Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver.

The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

Role

As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams.

You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written.

Tech environment

Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work.

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency.

Data Platform & Infrastructure:

  • Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python

  • Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup
  • Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform

G&A and GTM Data Pipelines & Automations:

  • Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch
  • Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success
  • Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams

AI Projects:

  • Contribute to AI-powered solutions, such as LLM pipelines that extract, classify, and enrich unstructured data (call transcripts, messages, tickets)
  • Build the data foundations these projects rely on: AI-ready datasets, usage and observability data, evaluation data
  • Apply data architecture principles that make our data reliable, well-documented, and safely accessible for AI use cases (context, retrieval, access scoping)

Monitoring & Support:

  • Monitor pipelines and automations, troubleshoot incidents, and fix root causes
  • Document data models, pipelines, and processes for both technical and business readers

Collaboration & Learning:

  • Work with stakeholders - as diverse as Finance, People, Sales, and Product - to understand requirements and translate them into data solutions
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions
  • Continuously expand your knowledge of data engineering, automation, and AI best practices

  • Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automation projects

description:

Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About the Role

As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team.

You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites, ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site.

Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required.

The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment.

Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required.

As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods.

Your Key Responsibilities:  

System operations & technical support

You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites.

    • Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems.
    • Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation.
    • Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path.
    • Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams.
    • Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions.
    • Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems.

Maintenance & customer-site interventions

You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

    • Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions.
    • Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention.
    • Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures.
    • Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions.
    • Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities.
    • Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements.

The role involves business travel within France and internationally, with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems.

User training & technical guidance

You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs.

    • Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities.
    • Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces.
    • Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation.

Documentation & continuous improvement

You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities.

    • Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports.
    • Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems.
    • Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures.
    • Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions.
    • Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems.

Requirements

Education & experience

  • Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field.
  • The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities.
  • Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred.
  • Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage.

Technical skills Required

  • Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software.
  • Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems.
  • Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues.
  • Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures.
  • Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions.
  • Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures.
  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics.
  • Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment.
  • Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems.
  • Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python.
  • Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment.
  • Experience delivering technical training to users or operators.

About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

About the Role

We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer.

Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client?

You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec, but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them.

If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design.

  • Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do.

  • Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster.

  • Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress.

  • Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty.

  • Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path.

Qualifications

  • 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus.

  • Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code.

  • Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python.

  • Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard.

  • Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet.

  • Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT.

  • Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written).

Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

 

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

 

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

title: Project Leider Bouw
description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.

We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.

Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.

Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf. Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken, of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet.

Over de functie

De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.

Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.

Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit.

We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat.

De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team.

Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat.

Wat je gaat doen

  • De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project.

  • Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers.

  • Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge.

  • Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk.

  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren.

  • Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators.

Wat we zoeken

  • Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder.

  • Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie.

  • Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden.

  • Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen.

  • Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren.

  • Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen.

  • Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert.

  • Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager.

Waarom Monumental?

Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je.

Helaas bieden we op dit moment geen stageplekken aan.

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen hierboven, maar ben je enthousiast over Monumental en denk je dat je ons toch kunt helpen moeilijke problemen op te lossen? Neem dan contact op. We verwelkomen generalisten die op resultaat gericht zijn en graag on the job leren.
